workflowArticle.proposedTitle: Moving from PC tune-up habits to Mac storage review
workflowArticle.primaryIntent: Help an AVG PC TuneUp user moving to Mac separate duplicate/photo housekeeping from rebuildable development-cache investigation; do not transplant Windows registry/Sleep Mode assumptions.
workflowArticle.leadDirection: Name the platform boundary first. Choose AVG's Mac edition for its documented duplicate/photo review; investigate storage owners and rebuild costs before considering a preview tool for development-cache work. No speedup promise.
workflowArticle.distinctMechanism: A migration task worksheet: file type, whether another copy is intentional, owning app/tool, rebuild/download cost, review selection and automation permissions. Compare oldest/newest duplicate preselection with ownership-based cache review, not generic cleaner rankings.
sections: Carry over the maintenance goal, not Windows-specific features
Separate identical files, similar photos and rebuildable caches
Review duplicate locations before Keep oldest or Keep newest
Inspect app/tool storage and rebuild cost before approving a cache action
Audit browser, Trash and exact-location automation separately
Choose a documented Mac tool or accept the preview limitations
workflowArticle.interactionPass: Handoff a static or interactive decision checklist: Windows only -> no Breathing Room substitution; personal Mac duplicate/photo task -> AVG documented controls; business use -> flag AVG sales-page restriction; developer-cache task -> inspect owner/rebuild cost, then disclose Breathing Room preview. Unknowns remain visible; no deletion/run button.
workflowArticle.visualPlan: First-party Space preview immediately after lead, preserving example-data banner. Official AVG Mac dashboard later only after rights and legibility clearance. Until then drafting remains blocked.
